target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes && echo "shadow_frontier/results/zoom_lnlam.bin" >> shadow_frontier/.gitignore && git add shadow_frontier/search/vhires_phase.c shadow_frontier/search/phase_diagram_zoom.py shadow_frontier/results/phase_diagram_zoom.npz shadow_frontier/results/zoom_lnlam.meta shadow_frontier/viz/fig6_candidate_region.png shadow_frontier/.gitignore && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Candidate-region zoom: the bracketed area [1.246, 4.08] x (0, eps*(D)]
at Delta-D = 0.001, p = 4000

Brackets the area where a counterexample's banded windows must live and
renders it at very high resolution (viz/fig6_candidate_region.png,
3000x2000 cells, 24 directions, 400 tilts, exact quantized states with
p=4000 orbits):

- BRACKET (from exact data): left wall D* = 1.24628; top boundary
  eps*(D) = 0.338/0.397/0.455/0.495/0.520/0.536 at D = 1.5..4.0,
  reaching 95% of saturation (0.538) at D = 4.08; the binary ceiling
  eps_bin = 0.449 crosses the boundary at D = 2.4464, splitting the
  region into a binary-accessible zone and a b>=3 wedge.
- Kinks at 2D in Z sharply resolved: slope jumps -0.0750 (D=1.5),
  -0.0100 (2.0), -0.0100 (2.5), -0.0050 (3.0), ~0 beyond - decaying
  arithmetic corners confirmed at 5x D-resolution and p=4000.
- Figure overlays: hatched candidate region (D > D*, eps < eps*(D)),
  counting wall, exclusion boundary with theta = 0.9/0.95/1.05/1.1
  margin contours, binary ceiling, kink markers, pilot-candidate
  point, and the {1,2}-emptiness note (theta_12 < 0.9791: for binary
  words the hatched region is empty).
- search/vhires_phase.c: parameters now overridable via -D defines
  (ND/NW/NT/P/BURN/DLO/DHI/OUTBASE); zoom variant built as
  zoom_phase. 230 MB intermediate gitignored; theta npz committed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "CANDIDATE-REGION ZOOM (fig6_candidate_region.png, phase_diagram_zoom.py, vhires_phase.c parameterized; pushed). Bracket from exact data: counterexample windows confined to [D*, ~4.08] x (0, eps*(D)]: D* = 1.24628; eps*(D) = 0.338/0.397/0.455/0.495/0.520/0.536 at D=1.5..4; 95% saturation (0.538) at D=4.08; binary ceiling 0.449 crosses boundary at D = 2.4464 (binary-accessible zone vs b>=3 wedge). Zoom render 3000x2000 cells (Delta-D 0.001, Delta-eps 0.0003), 24 omega, 400 tilts, p=4000: kinks at 2D in Z sharply resolved (slope jumps -0.075 at 1.5, -0.010 at 2.0/2.5, -0.005 at 3.0, ~0 beyond). Overlays: hatched candidate region, counting wall, margin contours 0.9-1.1, ceiling, pilot point, {1,2}-emptiness note. Engine now takes -DND/-DNT/-DP/-DDLO/-DDHI/-DOUTBASE for arbitrary window re-runs." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
